moves.label: Quick Itako Jab
moves.description: Quick high jab that checks close range with a small forward hand strike.
moves.reason: Compact standing poke with Anna's hand extended at head height.

moves.label: Low Sandal Kick
moves.description: Quick low kick with a short active window for simple shin pressure.
moves.reason: Low leg extension stays around the opponent's lower body line.

moves.label: Rosary Arc
moves.description: Quick mid bead swing that sweeps forward in a controlled arc.
moves.reason: Prayer beads visibly arc through mid-height contact frames.

moves.label: Rising Bead Kick
moves.description: Steady mid launcher that snaps upward after Anna steps in.
moves.reason: Rising leg and bead motion clearly lift through the target line.

moves.label: Rosary Frame Strike
moves.description: Steady mid link that chains Anna's bead arc into a quick follow-up.
moves.reason: Command reuses the mid bead arc and recovery frames.

moves.label: Itako Flip Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that flips Anna through a rising bead-assisted kick.
moves.reason: The sequence flips upward and ends in a launch-looking airborne strike.

moves.label: Low Spirit Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint that scatters spirit charms before a grounded step.
moves.reason: Low crouched posture and charm-like visual effects read as a deceptive low.

moves.label: Bead Snare Sweep
moves.description: Quick low launcher knockdown that hooks forward with Anna's rosary.
moves.reason: The beads drag low across the floor and the move is already a launcher knockdown.

moves.label: Rosary Power Crush
moves.description: Slow mid launcher knockdown that drives Anna through a heavy bead swing.
moves.reason: Committed bead rush and full-body drive support the power-crush role.

moves.label: Crouching Bead Tap
moves.description: Fast mid crouch poke that snaps Anna's beads upward from close range.
moves.reason: Short full-crouch animation centers on a quick upward bead tap.

moves.label: Crouch Spirit Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that rises out of crouch with a bead-led strike.
moves.reason: Two-frame crouch route resolves into a lifting bead attack.

moves.label: Itako Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown that channels Anna's beads through a long active rush.
moves.reason: Charge command and long bead rush read as her spirit-channeling power move.

moves.label: While-Rising Rosary
moves.description: Fast mid while-standing bead swing with a compact active window.
moves.reason: While-standing command reuses the controlled bead arc.

moves.label: Rising Spirit Kick
moves.description: Fast mid launcher that flips Anna upward before she crashes down.
moves.reason: The frames show a clear rising flip and airborne fall.

moves.label: Forward Rosary Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that steps in behind Anna's sweeping bead arc.
moves.reason: d/f route uses the mid bead arc and is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Forward Bead Rush
moves.description: Fast mid advancing rush that drags Anna's rosary across space.
moves.reason: The rope-like beads stretch forward before a close-range finish.

moves.label: Forward Rosary Arc
moves.description: Fast mid forward swing with a short active bead strike.
moves.reason: Forward command reuses the mid bead-arc contact frames.

moves.label: Oni Hand Burst
moves.description: Fast mid launcher knockdown that calls a huge guardian-hand strike forward.
moves.reason: Large spirit-hand visuals and heavy finish justify the guardian burst name.
